name: Chris Stigall
summary: Christopher Steven Stigall (born January 5, 1977) is an American politician, conservative talk radio personality, cable news contributor,  online columnist and host of The Chris Stigall podcast. He currently hosts the morning show on Salem Media Group's AM 990 The Answer in Philadelphia, and was the prior host of WPHT Morning Show in the Delaware Valley market from 2011 to March 2019.  Previously, he hosted The KCMO (AM) Morning Show in the Kansas City market from 2006 until 2010.
